title: Pet The Totem (Animated Pug)
description: Replaces the standard Totem of Undying with a wholesome, animated meme of petting a cute pug. Don't die, just pet the dog!
body:
![dog texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3bc61454ada5cf7daa49b07807a78463f5e541d0.gif)****Pet The Totem (Animated Pug)
Hey everyone! This resource pack replaces the boring old Totem of Undying with the wholesome, animated meme of a hand petting a cute pug. Now, whenever you are on the brink of defeat, instead of panicking, the game will gently remind you to just relax and pet the dog.

Quick Note: Hey, if the pack breaks for some reason, if the textures don't show up right, or if the animation bugs out on your version, I'm really sorry about that! This is one of my first custom packs, so please let me know in the comments if anything is wrong and I'll do my best to fix it.

Don't die, just pet the dog!
